args.body: Take IWMS-CHECKLIST-PUBLIC-DELIVERY. I read the existing checklist: it supplies concrete scope, weighting and preparation questions, but its mandatory section needs source verification before release. Deliver that existing value through the live page, bounded to one supplement and link; no new inventory or offer expansion. Stop after exact-digest review handoff, with no deployment this turn. Collection constrains paid acceptance only. Three unclassified feedback sources remain unknown demand, and publication would establish neither customers nor revenue.

description: The existing bid-readiness checklist contains practical supplier guidance that is not yet publicly delivered.
